newsitem.title: USA: China approves ITT Industries holding co.
newsitem.headline: China approves ITT Industries holding co.

text.p: China has given ITT Industries Inc permission to create a holding company to oversee its business operations already established in the country, the company said in a statement.

ITT said the holding company, to be known as ITT Industries (China) Investment Co Ltd, will be based in Beijing to oversee two automotive joint ventures by ITT Automotive, a pump manufacturing, a joint venture by ITT Fluid Technology and an electronic component joint venture company under the auspices of ITT Cannon.
Three additional automotive business ventures are under negotiations.
"The establishment of ITT Industries (China) Investment Co Ltd is a significant step in fulfilling our strategic plan to invest and grow in China and the Asia Pacific region," it said.
The holding company will manage sales, marketing, customer engineering support, purchasing, investing and other financial transactions for the businesses in the country, it added.
ITT Industries is a worldwide diversified manufacturing company, with 1995 sales of $8.4 billion from its three primary business segments: automotive, defense and electronics, and fluid technology.
